####################################################################################################
Purpose: To check missing data frames in each study

This data was used to request missing data, exclude studies or fix missing data in some studies. 

Data:
The working copy of the studies (unzipped and organized):
- in the bg/gsk_data folder 
The working copy of the vacc_con files of some studies (unzipped):
- in the bg/vacc_con_data folder 
####################################################################################################

# Set the working directory to the project directory
```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '~/Nextcloud/Projects/_seas_imm/code_exp_imm')
```

# Load packages, themes, directories, and functions
```{r}
source("00_pck.R")
```

# Load list of all study folders and files in the vacc_con directory
```{r}
# List all study folders
studies_folders <- sapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}")), simplify = FALSE,
                          function(x) list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{x}")))

# List all vacc_con files from the vacc_con directory
studies_vacc_con <- list.files(glue("{dirs$server_vacc_con}")) %>%
  str_remove_all("gsk_|_vacc_con.|csv|sas7bdat|v02.|rds") %>%
  str_replace("_", "-")
```

# Check the number of files for each expected data frame
```{r}
stu_missings <- list()
for (pat in names(studies_folders)) {
  for (stu in studies_folders[[pat]]) {
    stu.files <- str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$server_bg}/{pat}/{stu}")) ,"rds")
    stu_missings[[stu]] <- list(
      # Pathogen classification
      pathogen = pat,
      # Study ID
      study = stu,
      # Number of info files
      files.info = length(str_subset(stu.files, "info")),
      # Number of data files (excluding info files)
      files.data = length(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE)), 
      # Number of files for each expected data frame 
      # DF codelist: codes and meanings for the columns and values of the other data frames
      codelist = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "codelist")),
      # DF pid: data of the participants, center, country, rct group, and treatment
      pid = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "pid")),
      # DF demog: data of the participants, sex, age, date of enrollment 
      demog = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "demog")),
      # DF dates: data of the vaccination, serology and other dates
      dates = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "dates|date")),
      # DF expo_gn: data of the vaccine, administration, and dates
      expo_gn = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "expo_gn|treatmnt")),
      # DF sero_cod: data of the immunogenicity, serology name, method, and results
      sero_cod = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "sero_cod|labo_res|serology|labo")),
      # DF medic: data of concomitant medications
      medic = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "medic")),
      # DF unsol: data of adverse events 
      unsol = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "unsol|_ae.rds|reac")),
      # DF vacc_con: data of concomitant vaccinations
      vacc_con = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "vacc_con")),
      # Check if the files have CDI format
      cdi = length(str_subset(str_subset(stu.files, "info", negate = TRUE), "_adac")))
  }
} 

# Add additional vacc_con files
stu_missings <- bind_rows(stu_missings) %>%
  mutate(
    files.data = case_when(study %in% studies_vacc_con ~ files.data + 1, .default = files.data),
    vacc_con = case_when(study %in% studies_vacc_con ~ vacc_con + 1, .default = vacc_con)) %>%
  mutate(sum_true = codelist + pid + demog + dates + expo_gn + sero_cod + medic + unsol + vacc_con)

stu_missings
```

# Save data
```{r}
# Save tidy preliminary data of the requested studies 
saveRDS(stu_missings, file = glue("{dirs$processed}/stu_missingdfs.rds"))
```
